fusions.name: Unravel the Catch
fusions.desc: Pulls a thread of raw arcana through your mesh on the target, dealing 18 damage, up to 1.2 times that at full reach, and using up every affliction you have on it for 50% more damage each.

fusions.name: Crackling Mesh
fusions.desc: A mesh of raw arcana snaps out around you, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 25% chance to leave each [Muddled] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Skim the Ether
fusions.desc: Trails your mesh through the stray arcana around you, restoring 4 mana a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Spells Caught Mid-Air
fusions.desc: Your mesh catches elemental attacks aimed at you: 30% of the elemental damage you take is returned to whoever dealt it.
